name: Foxglove Ravine
description: The slopes of a deep ravine are overgrown with tall purple flowers.

scenes.name: Flowering Slope
scenes.description: The foxglove bells sway without wind, as though talking to one another.

scenes.name: Fallen Footbridge
scenes.description: An old footbridge lies across a stream, covered entirely in soft moss.

scenes.name: Herbalist's Stone
scenes.description: Dried herbs and a small amber object are laid out on a flat stone.
